content: Thank you for the feedback! I've made the corrections. I am planning a Part 2 of this puzzle that would allow 1) the extra tile to be rotated before inserting it into a row or column,  2) ability to "teleport" the player to the opposite side of the map if they are on an edge of a row or column that is shifted, and considering 3) the requirement find a path that would reach more than one treasure.

I'll review the puzzle in greater detail tomorrow. A few quick points first:

General
* Why is this Part 1? How many parts will there be, and how will the future parts differ?

Formatting
* Please study the formatting syntax described on this page: https://www.codingame.com/playgrounds/40701/help-center/statement , and format your statement properly as described in the points below.

Goal
* Please format 7 (in "7x7"), 1, 7 (in "1-7") and all possible tile characters as {{constants}}.

Input
* Please format "Lines 1-7" and "Line 8" in <<bold>>.

Output
* Please format "7 lines" in <<bold>>.

* Please format "#" as a {{constant}}.

Cover picture
* Please add a cover picture for the puzzle.

Thanks.

Thank you for updating the contribution and for sharing your Part 2 plan!

The plan sounds good. I'm looking forward to it! (Consider publishing the puzzle in WIP status first rather than directly as Ready 😉)

Goal
* I understand that "if necessary" means the extra tile may be unused, but currently it's inside brackets and reads more like an unimportant remark. Consider stating explicitly that using the extra tile is optional.

* Please clarify in the statement that, if the extra tile is used, it takes the leftmost/rightmost or topmost/bottommost position (as applicable), while the rightmost/leftmost or bottommost/topmost tile (as applicable) is removed from the map.

* Consider explaining the extra tile in its own paragraph instead of making it part of a longer paragraph, as it currently is.

* Please change both instances of "target" to "treasure" for clarity.

Output
* Please change "target" to "treasure".

Constraints
* Please add:
There are exactly one {{P}} and one {{T}} in each case.

Cases
* Please modify the current cases and add new ones so that there are separate case pairs for:

  • shifting the row left

  • shifting the row right

  • shifting the column up

  • shifting the column down

  • shifting the treasure

  • the extra tile is part of the path

* Currently, the path to the treasure contains "<" in validators only. Please make sure that there are also tests where the path to the treasure contains "<" when addressing the previous point.

* Currently, the directions of T relative to P in the initial state in the cases are:
  • E: 1 test, 1 validator
  • SE: 2 tests, 1 validator
  • S: none
  • SW: 1 validator
  • W: none
  • NW: 2 validators
  • N: 1 test

  When you modify/add cases, please make sure each direction appears in at least 1 test and at least 1 validator, to achieve more balanced coverage.

Thanks again.

(P.S. It's better to reply directly within the existing comment threads rather than creating new comments, so that the original authors are notified of your responses 😉)
Thank you for taking the time to help me with my first contribution! I will make the updates soon!
I made the updates and changed the status to Ready. Let me know if you have any other suggestions. Thanks!

Thanks. There are two remaining points:

* The extra tile is part of the path: Pair 1 already has that scenario, but it's a very simple one. Could you please add one or more pairs with a more complicated version of that scenario?

* Looking at the updated coverage for the direction of T relative to P in the initial state:
  • E: 1 test, 1 validator
  • SE: 2 tests, 1 validator
  • S: none
  • SW: 2 tests, 2 validators
  • W: 1 validator
  • NW: 2 validators
  • N: 2 tests
  • NE: 1 test, 1 validator

  Could you please modify/add cases to address the gaps?

  • Tests: S, W, NW

  • Validators: S, N
